quality.question: Which handoff failed, and will a proposed repair survive the next shift boundary?

assumptions.text: All times use the same local clock unless a record explicitly gives a correction.
Only named people and mechanisms in the case can be required for its resolution.

clauses.text: “Before 23:00” excludes exactly 23:00; “at or after” includes that instant.

identity.activity: Repair and test a small institutional process

motives.label: Protect people affected by the case

questions.text: The foreman closes a shift at 23:00. The cashier includes only shifts closed before 23:00, excluding exactly 23:00. The bank executes every submitted batch. Assign the failure to the missing handoff.
The previous batch includes shifts ending before 23:00. Which next-batch rule covers every boundary exactly once?
Under your repaired partition, place the test shifts. The old batch is before 23:00; the next is at or after 23:00.
Every record below uses the corrected hall clock. Learn how the correction works, or apply the procedure you already demonstrated.
At the same instant the bell record reads 19:00 and the hall clock reads 19:02. A hall photograph reads 19:08. Which corrected time belongs to it?
The next payroll includes the boundary shift once. Each clerk signs the revised handoff; the file names a failed interface rather than inventing a thief.
